prediction_1_delta_theta.name: Δθ Double-Well Bounce Gap
prediction_1_delta_theta.description: Simulates the quartic double-well and computes the Bounce-Gap (~0.14122°).
prediction_1_delta_theta.code_snippet:
def plot_func_1(ax):
    import numpy as np
    theta_lock = 109.47122
    a = 1.0
    b = 0.005
    peak_separation = np.sqrt(b / (2 * a))
    delta_theta = 2 * peak_separation
    theta_range = np.linspace(theta_lock - 1.0, theta_lock + 1.0, 500)
    V = a * (theta_range - theta_lock)**4 - b * (theta_range - theta_lock)**2
    ax.plot(theta_range, V, label='Double-Well Potential')
    ax.axvline(theta_lock, color='gray', linestyle='--', label=f'Tetra Lock {theta_lock:.5f}°')
    ax.axvline(theta_lock - peak_separation, color='red', linestyle=':', label=f'Peak 1')
    ax.axvline(theta_lock + peak_separation, color='red', linestyle=':', label=f'Peak 2')
    ax.set_title('Prediction #1: Bounce-Gap Split')
    ax.set_xlabel('Theta (°)')
    ax.set_ylabel('Potential')
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    print(f'Calculated Δθ Split: {delta_theta:.5f}°')
